senses.definition: to admire someone deeply because of their qualities, abilities, or achievements

examples.en: Students deeply respect her because of her dedication to teaching.
examples.vi: Học sinh rất kính trọng cô vì sự tận tâm trong giảng dạy.

senses.definition: to accept and follow a rule, law, custom, or agreement carefully

examples.en: Visitors must respect the local traditions while visiting the village.
examples.vi: Du khách phải tôn trọng các truyền thống địa phương khi đến thăm ngôi làng.

thesaurus.definition: regard highly; think much of
show respect towards

examples: She is an intellectual giant, and I respect her greatly.
wiktionary.gloss: To have respect for.

examples: I respect your right to hold that belief, although I think it is nonsense.
I respect your right to feel offended, even though most people, myself included, totally disagree and don’t find the comment offensive in the slightest.
wiktionary.gloss: To have regard for something, to observe a custom, practice, rule or right.

examples: They failed to respect the treaty they had signed, and invaded.
wiktionary.gloss: To abide by an agreement.
To take notice of; to regard as worthy of special consideration; to heed.
To relate to; to be concerned with.
